title: Priority Lane
heading: BadCode Shorts ▲ Priority Lane
moodboard_intro: Round 1, clean room: four shots in the rainy-night film look (Jack's reference). Tap This, Maybe or No on each still; leave a note per shot.

beats.name: A. The whole outside view
beats.blurb: The junction: the outrider's raised glove, the ambulance held at the red light, the motorcade coming through.

beats.name: B. Inside the ambulance
beats.blurb: The crew with the patient, the red light and the stopped traffic through the windscreen.

beats.name: C. The BadCode reporter
beats.blurb: On the pavement, mic in hand, to camera, with all of it behind.

beats.name: D. Inside the minister's car
beats.blurb: Back seat, on the phone, furious about lemon curd; blue lights through the rain.
